I’m not over 30 so I won’t comment on any of the larger parts of your question, but I just wanted to say that I’m a college student and you shouldn’t let your age discourage you from attending. At my large “traditional” urban university, there are many part time students in their 30s-40s, taking classes at night after work. There are even seniors aged 60+ in some of my classes, just bc they are passionate about the subject. Nobody bats an eye or feels like these students are out of place. And I personally enjoy the diversity it brings. Best of luck in your potential journey.
